kpis.description_fr: Volume vendu FY24 (Europe + APAC). Plus grand embouteilleur Coca-Cola par CA. 13 marchés (UK, FR, DE, ES + AU, NZ, Indo, PH).
kpis.description_en: Volume sold FY24 (Europe + APAC). Largest Coca-Cola bottler by revenue. 13 markets (UK, FR, DE, ES + AU, NZ, Indo, PH).

kpis.description_fr: Revenu par caisse FY24. Pricing + mix premiumization (no/low sugar, Costa Coffee RTD). +35% sur 5 ans.
kpis.description_en: Revenue per case FY24. Pricing + mix premiumization (no/low sugar, Costa Coffee RTD). +35% over 5 years.

kpis.description_fr: Part Coca-Cola Zero Sugar dans volumes CC trademark FY24. Trend santé/wellness, marges plus élevées (taxe sucre).
kpis.description_en: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar share of CC trademark volumes FY24. Health/wellness trend, higher margins (sugar tax).

kpis.description_fr: Volume Energy drinks FY24 (Monster, Relentless, Predator + Costa Coffee RTD). Catégorie hyper-croissance, marges supérieures.
kpis.description_en: Energy drinks volume FY24 (Monster, Relentless, Predator + Costa Coffee RTD). Hyper-growth category, higher margins.

kpis.description_fr: Marge op ajustée FY24. Expansion via pricing + mix + scale synergies API acquisition (Coca-Cola Amatil 2021).
kpis.description_en: FY24 comparable operating margin. Expansion via pricing + mix + API acquisition scale synergies (Coca-Cola Amatil 2021).

kpis_story.description_fr: Closing Feb 2024 acquisition Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines (CCBPI) pour ~$1.8Md (60% stake). Marché 110M habitants, croissance volume forte. Synergies API.
kpis_story.description_en: Feb 2024 closing of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines (CCBPI) ~$1.8Bn acquisition (60% stake). 110M population market, strong volume growth. API synergies.

_notes: Largest CC bottler by revenue. Source: AR FY24.
